scope: Alternative-blind finite-mixture family rejection and finite-grid range design; no continuum guarantee or new theory
design_rule: Enumerate every single lag and equally weighted distinct two-lag pair on lag_grid. Discrimination maximizes minimum summed Bhattacharyya distance among nulls. Range maximin maximizes minimum summed distance across 36 design alternatives and all nulls. Time-proxy objectives divide per-pair information by reset_cost plus mean lag. Ties use first grid order. Local Fisher maximizes nominal-null-1 scalar information, divided by cost in time mode.
mixture_rule: Uniform mixture over 36 full-dataset alternative likelihoods divided by maximum full-dataset null likelihood. Mixture weights and models fixed before evaluation; threshold 1/alpha. It is a mixture over entire experiments, not independent redraw of latent model per pair.
baselines: Same-data split likelihood and chi-square concentration tests from labs 20 and 21. Also always-warn and never-warn reference decisions. No oracle or calibration simulations.
time_rule: Reference time equals reference pairs times (reset_cost + mean previous lags). For each design floor affordable pairs to multiple 2*lag_count. Reset cost is a declared sensitivity proxy, NOT evidence that one unit yields independent equilibrium trials. All samples are independently prepared equilibrium pairs by assumption.
holdout: Evaluation aliases are absent from the design grid. No test outcomes may change schedules, mixture weights, thresholds, or budgets. This is not an external preregistration.
uncertainty: Per-cell Wilson 95 percent Monte Carlo intervals, not simultaneous. Independent scenario-design-budget streams; detector comparisons within each cell use the same data.
interpretation: Type-I guarantee only for nominal noise and exact null aliases at decay 0.2. Damping stress is outside null; sensor stress violates observation assumptions. Rejection is not a diagnosis of new physical dynamics. Nonrejection is not a response certificate.
